_readme: Extension-point registry: which applet/surface consumes which mchatai-source content, what shape it expects, and how to reload + verify it. CONTENT per mChatAI RULE #1 — served to agents by the portalExtensionPoints tunnel command; no rebuild to add an entry. This closes the discovery gap where each applet's Swift store hard-codes its own relative path with nothing telling an agent those paths exist.
_howToAdd: Copy an entry, point 'paths' at the real directories, name an existing file in 'exemplar' so an agent can imitate a known-good shape, and set 'reload' to the verb that makes the app re-read it. Entries are documentation, not a gate: an applet works whether or not it is listed here, and an agent may extend surfaces that are not listed.

extensionPoints.summary: Genre material packs: the loops, one-shots, and per-genre musical material LoopStar builds arrangements from.
extensionPoints.verify: Open LoopStar and audition the genre. Audio MUST be verified by ear — the diagnostic meters read 0 even while audio plays.
extensionPoints.notes: Audio filenames follow a per-genre prefix convention (lsbl_* for blues). Add the genre to packs.json or it will not be listed.

extensionPoints.summary: Playable phrase library — melodic/rhythmic phrases installed onto part channels.
extensionPoints.verify: Install a phrase in LoopStar and listen. Phrases ride PART channels, not lanes.

extensionPoints.summary: Song Book entries: form, changes, and head material for songs the applet can load.
extensionPoints.verify: Load the song in LoopStar's Song Book and play it.
extensionPoints.notes: The SONG owns form/changes/head; the STYLE owns groove (beat/bass/comping). Keep those concerns separate.

extensionPoints.summary: Drum kits, drum-synth presets, and lane FX presets.
Character rigs the animator can cast and pose.
extensionPoints.verify: Open ToonStudio, cast the puppet, and render a short.
extensionPoints.notes: User-authored library items live on the user's machine and take precedence over source-cache entries.

extensionPoints.summary: Scene backdrops and the sound-effect library.
extensionPoints.verify: Place the backdrop / trigger the sound in a ToonStudio scene.

extensionPoints.summary: Generation prompts and tuning values for script/scene generation.
extensionPoints.verify: Generate a short and inspect the result; ToonFidelity gates audit the output.

extensionPoints.summary: Prompt templates behind StoryMaker's AI actions (outline, expand chapter, character sheet, plot analysis, dialogue polish) plus the freeform/custom operation templates.
extensionPoints.verify: Run the corresponding AI action inside StoryMaker on a test project.

extensionPoints.summary: The web Lego catalog: reusable components, 3D components, and vendored offline libraries mini-apps are assembled from.
extensionPoints.notes: Components must work offline — a published mini-app runs under a CSP that blocks CDNs. Extract anything reusable here rather than inlining it in one app.

extensionPoints.summary: Wisdom rule packs that steer generation. universal.json applies to every build; other packs are scoped.
extensionPoints.verify: Run a wizard build that should trigger the rule and inspect the result.
extensionPoints.notes: Source is the authoritative superset. The app's bundled WizardWisdom copies are FROZEN offline fallbacks — never hand-edit those.

extensionPoints.summary: Harness policy content: routing and escalation thresholds, gates, steering, context recipes, playability rules.
extensionPoints.verify: Use the matching diag verb (for example diagEscalation) to inspect the resolved values.
extensionPoints.notes: Values are clamped on load — a malformed edit falls back to frozen defaults rather than disabling a gate.

extensionPoints.summary: Shared content primitives: word dictionaries, color palettes, holiday calendars, emoji catalog, unit conversions.
extensionPoints.verify: diagFundamentals tunnel command lists what resolved.

extensionPoints.summary: JavaScript skills auto-installed into the app at launch and on refresh.
extensionPoints.verify: listSkills, then runSkill against the new id.

extensionPoints.summary: Pipeline Lego steps and full pipeline templates.
extensionPoints.notes: A saved pipeline snapshot shadows a catalog template of the same name; purgeSavedPipeline clears a stale one.

extensionPoints.summary: Python microservice source users can opt into installing on their own machine.
extensionPoints.verify: Install via Diagnostics, then call the service's health endpoint.
extensionPoints.notes: RULE #2: these run on the user's machine, never centrally. Installation is always opt-in.
